Class LoanService

java.lang.Object
lms.application.LoanService
public class LoanService extends Object
Application service coordinating loan operations in the Library Management System.

This service manages the complete lifecycle of library item loans including:

  • Creating new loans (borrowing items)
  • Returning items and calculating fines
  • Extending loan periods
  • Checking for overdue loans and sending notifications
  • Managing loan status and history

Key Features:

  • Validates user borrowing eligibility (limits, fines, account status)
  • Manages item availability and copy counts
  • Automatic fine calculation for overdue items
  • Email and in-system notifications for overdue items
  • Support for multiple item types (books, CDs, journals)

The service uses LoanServiceContext to access all necessary repositories and the notification service, following the Context pattern to reduce constructor parameter count.

  • Method Details

    • loanItem

      public Loan loanItem(UserDTO userDTO, UUID itemId, String itemType) throws UserNotFoundException, ItemNotFoundException, ItemNotAvailableException, BorrowNotAllowedException, LoanAlreadyExistsException
      Loans a library item to a user.

      This method performs the following operations:

      1. Validates that the user exists and can borrow items
      2. Verifies that the requested item is available
      3. Creates a new loan record
      4. Updates the item's available copy count
      5. Updates the user's loan records
      Parameters:
      userDTO - the user data transfer object containing user information
      itemId - the unique identifier of the item to loan
      itemType - the type of item (e.g., "book", "cd", "journal")
      Returns:
      the created Loan object
      Throws:
      UserNotFoundException - if the user does not exist
      ItemNotFoundException - if the item does not exist
      ItemNotAvailableException - if the item is not available for borrowing
      BorrowNotAllowedException - if the user has reached their borrowing limit
      LoanAlreadyExistsException

    • returnItem

      public boolean returnItem(UUID userID, UUID loanID) throws IllegalArgumentException, IllegalStateException, UserNotFoundException, ItemNotFoundException, LoanNotFoundException, PermissionDeniedException
      Processes the return of a loaned item.

      This method handles the complete return process including:

      • Validating the loan exists and hasn't been returned
      • Marking the loan as returned
      • Incrementing the available copy count for the item
      • Calculating and applying late fines if the item is overdue
      • Updating all relevant repositories
      Parameters:
      userID - the unique identifier of the user returning the item
      loanID - the unique identifier of the loan to return
      Returns:
      true if the return operation is successful
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the loan does not exist
      IllegalStateException - if the item has already been returned
      UserNotFoundException - if the user associated with the loan is not found
      ItemNotFoundException - if the item associated with the loan is not found
      LoanNotFoundException
      PermissionDeniedException
